outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured microscopy images from a photoactivation time-lapse experiment, without quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents averaged intensity data with error bars (insets) and model fits derived from replicated measurements, but the legend never states how many replicates (cells, experiments, or regions) were averaged nor what kind of replicate (biological/technical) they represent.
